message.content:
Below is a consolidated list of **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or a holiday that, when combined with a weekend, gives you a three‑day break).  Provincial holidays that create long weekends are also included.

| Date | Holiday | Province(s) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20, 2023** | Family Day | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | **Feb 18–20** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Mar 17, 2023** | St. Patrick’s Day | Ontario | **Mar 17–19** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Apr 7, 2023** | Good Friday | All provinces | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Apr 23, 2023** | St. George’s Day | British Columbia | **Apr 23–25** (Fri–Sun) |
| **May 22, 2023** | Victoria Day | All provinces | **May 20–22** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Aug 7, 2023** | Civic Holiday | Ontario, British Columbia, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick | **Aug 5–7** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Sep 4, 2023** | Labour Day | All provinces | **Sep 2–4** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Oct 9, 2023** | Thanksgiving | All provinces | **Oct 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| **Dec 23–25, 2023** | Christmas & Boxing Day | All provinces | **Dec 23–25** (Fri–Sun) |

### Notes

1. **Canada Day (Jul 1)** falls on a Saturday in 2023, so it does not create a long weekend.  
2. **Remembrance Day (Nov 11)** falls on a Saturday, so it also does not create a long weekend.  
3. Some provinces have additional holidays that may create long weekends (e.g., **St. Patrick’s Day** in Ontario, **St. George’s Day** in BC).  
4. If you’re planning trips in provinces that observe a holiday on a Thursday or Tuesday, you could still create a long weekend by taking an extra day off, but those are not official public holidays.

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.) let me know!
